logic_summary: 6-byte ramp table {0,4,9,14,18,14}. Sole consumer fd2_execute_special_attack_skill (@ 0x276EC) copies the whole 6 bytes into a stack-local in one shot (MOVSD at 0x2773F + MOVSW at 0x27740), then in the per-sub-frame render loop byte-indexes that local copy by a shake counter that is latched to 5 on each landed hit and decays toward 0; the looked-up value is subtracted from the work-buffer X pointer to nudge the sprite left, producing a quick jolt that settles. Same shape/role as the combat-hit horizontal shake table @ 0x5255F (data_fd2_battle_combat_hit_shake_x_offset_table).
